title: The Outreach Tech Stack you can run with Claude Code
blurb: A full sales-outreach stack mapped by integration type — Native MCP, 3rd-party MCP, or API — across six functional buckets.
body:
Every major outreach tool, mapped to how it connects to Claude Code (Native MCP / 3rd-party MCP / API):

Enterprise sales engagement

Outreach (Native MCP) · Salesloft (3rd-party MCP)

Cold email sequencing

Instantly.ai · Smartlead · Woodpecker (all 3rd-party MCP)

LinkedIn outreach & automation

HeyReach (Native MCP) · Expandi · Dripify · SalesRobot · Skylead · Waalaxy (API)

Multichannel platforms

Lemlist (Native MCP) · Reply · Snov.io · Klenty (3rd-party MCP) · LaGrowthMachine · Salesforge.ai (API)

AI SDRs & autonomous outbound

Artisan · 11x · AiSDR (API)

Data & enrichment

ZoomInfo · Apollo (Native MCP)

SOURCE · "Outreach Tech Stack," presented by Massive.
